title: Not possible to turn off persistent notification
symptom: After updating xDrip+, the persistent notification cannot be turned off or removed. Unchecking 'Run Collector in foreground' removes it temporarily, but it reappears. The notification data does not update correctly and shows old data.
cause: Without a persistent notification on Android 8 and above, xDrip will be killed by Android.
fix: To minimize or hide the notification, long press on the notification, or go to Settings -> Glucose Alert Settings and enable the notification channels checkboxes, then wait a few minutes and adjust the notification channel for the ongoing notification.
evidence_quote: Without a persistent notification on Android 8 and above xDrip will be killed by Android. To minimize this notification either just select to minimize it or not show it by long pressing on the notification or if it isn't that simple on your phone, go in to `Settings -> Glucose Alert Settings` and enable the notification channels checkboxes and then wait a few minutes and then you should be able to adjust just the notification channel for the ongoing notification.
